title: 同時発動順序 検証仕様

source_constraints.battle_v5: 同一Tick内の処理順は一度決定し、Tick内は維持し、次Tickで再決定する。
source_constraints.v9_determinism: 対象順・タグ評価順・派生処理順を決定可能にし、同一入力・同一Seed・同一ルール版で同一結果を再現する。
source_constraints.v9_tie_rule: 同順位処理の具体規則は正式保留。

candidate_rule.scope: same activation priority among base reserved actions due in the same tick
candidate_rule.basis: preserve the existing pre-P01-12 dueBase order; this is a candidate observation, not yet a formal V9 rule
candidate_rule.priority_relation: ACTIVATION_PRIORITY remains the primary key; this candidate applies only when priorities are equal

acceptance: equal priority + different gauge overflow follows existing due order
equal priority + equal post-increment gauge follows higher AGI
fixed order and committed order agree
